_comment: Shown on the dashboard's Label page. Suite content: every suite writes its own. Rubric-specific PASS/FAIL guidance comes from the rubric files themselves (and, for llm_as_judge, from the vendored rubric), so it cannot drift from what the judges use.
role: Read each reply as the customer would, or as a support manager checking the agent's work. Answer one question: is this reply good enough to send?
steps: Read what the customer said (the whole exchange, for multi-turn cases).
Open 'What the tools returned' - that is everything the agent knew. Anything in the reply that no tool returned was invented.
Read the agent's final reply and apply the card's PASS / FAIL guidance.
Write one line saying why. Not sure? Skip it - 30 confident labels beat 50 guesses.
agent_rules: Before changing any order (cancel or refund), call verify_customer first.
Never cancel or refund an order the caller does not own - refuse politely and offer support.
If the request is ambiguous (e.g. 'my order' with two orders), ask which one - never guess.
If a tool fails, say so plainly and never claim success. If money is involved, escalate (actually call escalate - saying it is not enough).
Be brief and concrete, and mention the order number acted on.
